properties.title: Lineaments
properties.description:
A lineament is a linear feature in a landscape which is an expression of an underlying geological structure such as a fault [1]. Lineament is also an important hydrological variable because of its potential to provide groundwater recharge. 

The map has been generated from state-wise lineaments data available on [Bhuvan](https://bhuvan.nrsc.gov.in/home/index.php) portal.
